hooks.name: Rebuild Tailwind CSS on template or style save
hooks.description: Keeps app/static/css/app.css in sync with the Tailwind classes used in templates and viewer scripts, so the committed CSS is always current.

action.command: npx --yes tailwindcss@3.4 -c tailwind.config.js -i app/static/css/src.css -o app/static/css/app.css --minify 2>&1 | tail -2
